brief:
Settlers dismantled a metal fence from agricultural land northeast of Ramallah, Shehab Wire reported. The incident occurred on land owned by Palestinians in the region north and east of the West Bank city. The removal of the fence represents another encroachment on Palestinian property in an area where such disputes over land access and use have grown increasingly common.

The exact timing of the fence removal and the number of settlers involved were not immediately clear. Palestinian residents have faced repeated incidents involving structural damage and land incursions across the Ramallah area, where competing claims over territory remain a persistent source of friction.
